# Summary

Describe the problem and the outcome of this change.

## Scope and motivation

Explain why the change is needed, what is intentionally included, and what remains out of scope. Link the related issue when one exists.

## User impact and risk

Describe any user-visible behavior, compatibility, security, persistence, or operational risk. Write “none” when the change has no such impact.

## Validation

List the exact commands or manual checks you ran and their results. Start with the narrowest relevant tests; package-wide, root-wide, and release checks are needed only when the affected boundary requires them. If a relevant check was not run, state why.

Do not include credentials, tokens, SecretStore data, private file contents, personal information, or unreviewed full logs in this pull request.
